api.title: Use the Nixflex API
api.description: Explore the Nixflex API for voice agents, calls, numbers, SMS and knowledge. Find authentication, request fields, response shapes and examples.
api.lead: Build voice, SMS and knowledge workflows through the documented Nixflex API.
important: Start with a read-only usage request to check the account.
Use only documented public operations; a dashboard feature is not automatically an API endpoint.

api.title: Authenticate API requests
api.description: Authenticate Nixflex API requests with a server-side key. Understand account ownership, personal sessions and Owner, Admin and Member permissions.
api.lead: Authenticate server requests with the owning account credential and follow the permission rule for each operation.
important: Keep the full account credential on your server.
Personal roles and organisation API keys have different authority; follow the operation-specific rule.

api.title: Handle API errors
api.description: Find Nixflex API error codes, HTTP statuses and recovery steps. Distinguish invalid input, permission failures, temporary errors and uncertain results.
api.lead: Use the machine-readable error code and the current resource state to decide what to do next.
important: Branch on error.code, not the wording of error.message.
Unknown write outcomes require reconciliation before another deliberate action.

api.title: Page through API results
api.description: Page through Nixflex agents, calls, numbers and knowledge. Use each endpoint’s limit, offset or cursor without losing filters or assuming one list shape.
api.lead: Read every result by following the pagination shape and filters documented for that endpoint.
important: Use the paging shape documented for the specific endpoint.
Keep filters fixed between pages; do not treat one response as a complete account export.

api.title: Handle API rate limits
api.description: Handle Nixflex API rate limits using RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and Retry-After. Keep request quotas separate from call capacity and feature limits.
api.lead: Use the returned rate-limit guidance to control request frequency and keep call capacity checks separate.
important: Read the actual rate-limit headers when returned.
A rate limit and call capacity are separate controls.

api.title: Reuse supported operation identities
api.description: Use Nixflex knowledge operation keys and revisions correctly. Learn which requests support replay and how to handle uncertain calls, SMS and other writes.
api.lead: Keep one operation identity for one intended action only where the endpoint documents replay support.
important: An operation identity protects only the operation that documents it.
For outbound calls, save the UUID request_id before launch and retain it while the outcome is uncertain.

api.title: Receive and verify webhook events
api.description: Receive Nixflex call and booking events. Verify raw-body signatures, handle duplicate delivery and fetch private recording links when playback is needed.
api.lead: Verify signed Nixflex events before storing their results or running a business action.
important: Verify the exact body bytes before parsing or taking action.
Delivery can be delayed, duplicated or missed; keep a reconciliation path.

api.title: Retry failed API requests
api.description: Choose safe retry behavior for Nixflex API reads and writes. Honor Retry-After, reconcile unknown outcomes and avoid duplicate calls, messages or purchases.
api.lead: Retry eligible reads with a limit, and reconcile uncertain writes before any deliberate new action.
important: Use bounded retries for eligible reads.
Never automatically create a new call intent to recover an unknown launch result.

api.title: Track API versions and compatibility
api.description: Track Nixflex API compatibility, additive fields and retired routes. Preserve unknown values and confirm client support before changing a live integration.
api.lead: Use the versioned API contract and verify client support before relying on a new field or operation.
important: Use /v1 and keep identifiers and nullable fields intact.
Check the deployed API and client release together before using a new capability.

api.title: Understand agent settings and defaults
api.description: Understand Nixflex agent fields, defaults, limits and nullable values. Configure call behavior, prompts, keyterms, retention and supported channel settings.
api.lead: Use saved agent values and number overrides to determine the effective call settings.
important: Omitted update fields keep saved values.
Number overrides can change the effective settings for one phone number.

api.title: Create an agent
api.description: Create an agent and receive its agent_id for later reads, updates and calls. A successful create does not assign a phone number or start a call.
api.lead: Create an agent and receive its `agent_id` for later reads, updates and calls.
important: A new agent starts with the documented defaults; read the saved agent before attaching a number.
A successful create does not assign a phone number or start a call.
api.introDetails: Every request field is optional. Sending `{}` creates an agent with the default settings. Calls have a **300-second duration limit**, a **10-second silence hang-up** and **dynamic greeting enabled** by default. Creating an agent does not place a call or import a phone number.

api.title: List agents
api.description: List Nixflex agents owned by the account. Read their settings and use each agent ID for detail, update or disable requests.
api.lead: List owned agents, with active agents selected by default.
important: Use the returned agent IDs for later reads and changes.
An empty list only describes this account and the requested page.
api.introDetails: Use the optional status and search filters. Results are a bare array, ordered by created_at DESC then agent_id DESC. Invalid paging or filter queries return 400 invalid_agent_list.

api.title: Get an agent
api.description: Read one Nixflex agent and its saved settings. Check whether it is active before assigning numbers or starting calls.
api.lead: Get an agent in the authenticated account.
important: Read the saved agent before changing shared behaviour.
A number override may change the effective value for a particular call.

api.title: Update an agent
api.description: Update selected settings on an owned Nixflex agent. The PUT request is partial: omitted fields keep their saved values.
api.lead: Change selected settings on an account-owned agent. Although the method is PUT, this is a partial update: omitted fields keep their saved values. Creation defaults are not reapplied.
important: Omitted fields keep their stored values; send only the intended change.
Read the agent after an uncertain response before repeating the update.

api.title: Disable an agent
api.description: Disable an owned Nixflex agent. Understand the inactive state, retained record and checks before assigning numbers or starting calls.
api.lead: Switch an owned agent off by setting is_active to false. GET still returns the inactive record. This is not permanent erasure.
important: This sets is_active:false; the owned agent record remains readable.
It does not detach numbers, erase history or wait for live calls to finish.

api.title: List phone numbers
api.description: List phone numbers owned by the Nixflex account. Read assigned agents and saved number settings before routing or configuration changes.
api.lead: List the public phone numbers owned by the authenticated account.
important: Use E.164 phone numbers as returned by the API.
Check assignment and channel switches before choosing a number for work.
api.introDetails: Pending imports and internal browser identities are hidden. Without limit/cursor the legacy envelope stays unchanged. count is returned rows, not total. Paged reads order by created_at DESC NULLS LAST, then phone_number DESC; this is live traversal, not a snapshot.

api.title: Get a phone number
api.description: Read one owned Nixflex phone number, its assigned agent and saved settings. Use the encoded international number in the request path.
api.lead: Get a phone number in the authenticated account.
important: Read the number's own settings and its assigned agent.
A null override can inherit an agent value; it is not necessarily disabled.

api.title: Import a phone number
api.description: Import a phone number you own into Nixflex and assign it to an active agent. Review existing routing before changing the number configuration.
api.lead: Connect a number you already own to an active agent on the same account. Import can replace existing number routing, so another application using that routing can stop receiving calls or texts.
important: This connects an existing supported number to the account.
A pending import is not permission to send; wait for a usable state.

api.title: Update a phone number
api.description: Update an owned Nixflex number's settings or move it to another active agent on the account. Review routing and uncertain outcomes before retrying.
api.lead: Change per-number settings, or move the number to another active agent on the same account. A move and a settings update are separate requests.
important: Change only the fields you intend; omission preserves saved values.
Read back the number and check its effective agent assignment.

api.title: Get number usage
api.description: Read usage for an owned Nixflex phone number. Check the response fields and account scope before using the totals in your application.
api.lead: Get number usage in the authenticated account.
important: These usage counters describe the selected owned number.
Do not use counters as an invoice or a complete charge ledger.

api.title: Remove a phone number
api.description: Disconnect an owned number from Nixflex and clear routing managed by its import. This does not release the number from your carrier account.
api.lead: Disconnect an owned number from Nixflex and clear the routing managed by this import. This does not release the number from its carrier account or end that account’s charges.
important: Removal changes the number connection; check the exact target first.
Tracked cleanup may remain pending after the request is accepted.

api.title: List calls
api.description: Read the legacy call list as a bare array, newest creation time first. Use the documented filters and page limits.
api.lead: Read the legacy call list as a bare array, newest creation time first. Use the history operation when you need filters, totals, failed-start entries or cursor paging.
important: Use the documented filters and page limits.
A call row can exist before analysis, recording and booking work finishes.

api.title: Get call history
api.description: Read a filtered call-history envelope with matching totals. History includes failed starts and omits transcripts, event data, extracted data and recording URLs.
api.lead: Read a filtered call-history envelope with matching totals. History includes failed starts and omits transcripts, event data, extracted data and recording URLs.
important: Keep the same filters while paging through history.
Unknown outcome and missing analysis must stay unknown in your UI.

api.title: Get a call
api.description: Read one account-owned call. Call completion is separate from recording, analysis and booking finalisation.
api.lead: Read one account-owned call. Use view=detail for the explicit nullable detail shape, failed-start IDs and retained metadata stubs. Omitting view keeps the legacy row response.
important: Use the returned call ID to reconcile this call.
Call completion is separate from recording, analysis and booking finalisation.

api.title: Get a call recording
api.description: Read Nixflex call recording status and obtain a fresh signed download link when available. Handle unavailable, pending and deleted recordings.
api.lead: Read recording status and obtain a fresh signed download link when the managed recording is available. This operation does not read or verify an account-connected storage object.
important: Fetch a fresh link when the user asks to play the recording.
A missing URL is not proof of deletion; show the returned recording state.

api.title: Create an outbound call
api.description: Start an outbound call with an optional saved UUID. Reconcile replayed, pending and unknown requests without automatically placing another call.
api.lead: Start one outbound call from an account-owned number assigned to an active agent. A 201 response means the call was initiated; it does not prove connection, conversation, completion or a successful outcome.
important: Save one UUID request_id before a deliberate call intent if you need launch reconciliation.
A 201 means initiated. A same-ID 200 replay returns the existing call; pending or unknown must never trigger a new UUID automatically.

api.title: Handle call outcomes and safe retries
api.description: Handle Nixflex call starts, active calls, deletions and unknown outcomes. Use confirmed state before retrying actions or treating a call as completed.
api.lead: Reconcile a call launch from its saved request or call ID before deciding whether another action is appropriate.
important: A 201 launch reply means initiated, not connected or completed.
Use the saved request UUID to reconcile pending or unknown launches without redialling.

api.title: Delete a call
api.description: Delete an owned Nixflex call with guarded recording cleanup. Handle blocked or uncertain results without treating them as confirmed deletion.
api.lead: Request guarded cleanup for one owned call.
important: Only the server can confirm that required cleanup and evidence checks have finished.
A missing recording link or an empty file list does not prove deletion completed.
api.introDetails: In-progress or unsettled work and pending or failed cleanup can return 409/503. This is not a promise of immediate all-copy erasure. Reconcile an uncertain response before another deliberate action.

api.title: Delete all calls
api.description: Request guarded deletion of Nixflex call data for the account. Review scope, cleanup requirements and uncertain outcomes before another request.
api.lead: Request guarded cleanup of the account’s calls without deleting SMS or closing the account.
important: This affects the account's call history; confirm the scope before sending.
A single-call cleanup rule does not automatically apply to bulk deletion.
api.introDetails: Work or cleanup confirmation can remain pending and return 409/503. Legacy recording counters are not all-copy erasure proof. Reconcile an uncertain response before another deliberate action.

api.title: List voice campaigns
api.description: List this account’s voice campaigns, newest first. This bounded list has no offset or cursor.
api.lead: List this account’s voice campaigns, newest first. This bounded list has no offset or cursor.
important: Read saved campaign state before any launch, cancel or resume action.
The campaign list does not prove every recipient finished.

api.title: Create a voice campaign
api.description: Create a Nixflex voice campaign and its recipients. Default now mode requests launch immediately; use schedule mode to prepare a later launch.
api.lead: Create a voice campaign and its recipient rows. The default now mode immediately requests launch; schedule mode saves scheduled work that can run automatically. There is no public draft-only flag.
important: The default now mode immediately requests launch; scheduled work can run automatically. There is no public draft-only mode.
Review recipients, consent and contact rules before creating the campaign, because creation can contact people.

api.title: Launch a voice campaign
api.description: Request the first launch of an owned Nixflex voice campaign. Check readiness, consent and launch state before dispatching calls.
api.lead: Request the first launch of an owned voice campaign. Ownership, readiness and launch state are checked before dispatch; each recipient still passes current contact checks.
important: Launching can contact real recipients; review the selected campaign first.
An uncertain launch must be reconciled from campaign state, not launched again blindly.

api.title: Cancel voice campaign
api.description: Cancel future work for an owned voice campaign. Calls or messages already in progress may finish.
api.lead: Cancel future work for an owned voice campaign. Calls or messages already in progress may finish.
important: Cancellation stops eligible future work; it cannot recall a dispatched call.
Read campaign state to see what remains active or pending.

api.title: Resume voice campaign
api.description: Resume a bounded page of verified, unattempted recipients in a running Nixflex voice campaign. Review consent and current campaign state first.
api.lead: Resume one bounded page of verified unattempted recipients in the current running voice campaign. This can dispatch contact and keeps the existing launch generation.
important: This resumes a bounded page of verified unattempted recipients in the current running campaign.
It can dispatch contact and keeps the existing launch generation; uncertain recipients must not become fresh contacts.

api.title: Record voice consent
api.description: Record consent or withdrawal for the current Nixflex voice campaign policy revision. Review the audience and policy before confirming.
api.lead: Record a consent or consent-withdrawal decision for the current voice campaign policy revision. The owner confirms the selected event explicitly.
important: Record actual consent for the intended campaign.
This record does not bypass suppression or recipient-local contact checks.

api.title: Send an SMS
api.description: Send one SMS through Nixflex using an explicit, owned sender assigned to the agent. Distinguish acceptance from delivery and handle uncertain results.
api.lead: Send one SMS using an explicit sender owned by the account and assigned to the requested agent. A 201 sent response means the send was accepted; it is not proof of delivery to the recipient.
important: This request can send a real text; there is no general replay guarantee.
Carrier acceptance is not proof that the recipient read or received the message.

api.title: List SMS campaigns
api.description: List the account's Nixflex SMS campaigns, newest first. Delivery totals cover all campaign recipients, beyond the current recipient page.
api.lead: List this account’s SMS campaigns, newest first. Delivery totals cover all campaign recipients, not just the returned page.
important: Use saved campaign IDs for detail and action requests.
A list summary is not the complete recipient outcome record.

api.title: Create an SMS campaign
api.description: Create a Nixflex SMS campaign and its recipients. Default now mode requests launch immediately; use schedule mode to prepare a later launch.
api.lead: Create an SMS campaign and its recipient rows. The default now mode immediately requests launch; schedule mode saves scheduled work that can run automatically. There is no public draft-only flag.
important: The default now mode immediately requests launch; scheduled work can run automatically. There is no public draft-only mode.
Review recipients, consent and message content before creating the campaign, because creation can send messages.

api.title: Get an SMS campaign
api.description: Read one owned SMS campaign with recipient and message history. The campaign counters cover the whole campaign; the two history lists have independent cursors.
api.lead: Read one owned SMS campaign with recipient and message history. The campaign counters cover the whole campaign; the two history lists have independent cursors.
important: Read this campaign before changing its state.
Keep accepted, pending, failed and uncertain recipient results distinct.

api.title: Update SMS reply settings
api.description: Update reply behaviour for an owned Nixflex SMS campaign. This request does not edit the campaign's recipients, schedule or outbound message.
api.lead: Update reply behaviour for one owned SMS campaign. This operation does not edit its recipients, schedule or message template, and it is not a cancellation control.
important: These settings control replies associated with the campaign.
A saved reply setting does not launch or resend campaign messages.

api.title: Launch an SMS campaign
api.description: Request the first launch of an owned Nixflex SMS campaign. Check readiness, consent and launch state before dispatching messages.
api.lead: Request the first launch of an owned SMS campaign. Ownership, readiness and launch state are checked before dispatch; each recipient still passes current contact checks.
important: Launching can send real messages to the saved recipients.
After a lost response, read campaign state before a deliberate next action.

api.title: Cancel SMS campaign
api.description: Cancel future work for an owned SMS campaign. Calls or messages already in progress may finish.
api.lead: Cancel future work for an owned SMS campaign. Calls or messages already in progress may finish.
important: Cancellation cannot recall messages already dispatched.
Read current state before claiming that all contact stopped.

api.title: Resume SMS campaign
api.description: Resume a bounded page of verified, unattempted recipients in a running Nixflex SMS campaign. This can dispatch messages after policy checks.
api.lead: Resume one bounded page of verified unattempted recipients in the current running SMS campaign. This can dispatch contact and keeps the existing launch generation.
important: This resumes a bounded page of verified unattempted recipients in the current running campaign.
It can dispatch messages and keeps the existing launch generation; do not create a second campaign to recover an uncertain result.

api.title: Record SMS consent
api.description: Record consent or withdrawal for the current Nixflex SMS campaign policy revision. Review the audience and policy before confirming.
api.lead: Record a consent or consent-withdrawal decision for the current SMS campaign policy revision. The owner confirms the selected event explicitly.
important: Save consent only when it was actually obtained.
A consent record does not override suppression or allowed contact hours.

api.title: Delete an SMS campaign
api.description: Delete a settled Nixflex SMS campaign. Handle active-work conflicts, pending settlement and unknown results before removing it from your application.
api.lead: Delete an owned SMS campaign only after active work and final settlement are resolved.
important: Confirm the saved campaign ID and deletion conditions first.
Deleting campaign data does not retract a delivered message.

api.title: Get knowledge capabilities
api.description: Read knowledge limits, defaults and the account scope marker before enabling import, review and testing controls in your app.
api.lead: Read current knowledge limits, defaults and account scope marker.
important: Read supported actions and bounds before enabling a knowledge UI.
Capability availability is not a promise that a particular write will be admitted.

api.title: List knowledge agents
api.description: List active owned agents and their live knowledge state, then use the returned agent IDs for scoped knowledge operations.
api.lead: List active owned agents and their live knowledge state.
important: Choose an owned agent from the returned targets.
Keep opaque IDs unchanged; names are not stable identities.

api.title: Get agent knowledge
api.description: Read an agent’s own knowledge base, settings and current revision. Keep a missing base distinct from an unavailable read.
api.lead: Read the agent’s own knowledge base, settings and current revision.
important: Read this agent’s own knowledge base, settings and current revision.
A missing base is different from a failed read; preserve that distinction.

api.title: Set agent knowledge
api.description: Create an agent’s knowledge base or update its settings with the current revision. Saving settings does not publish source text.
api.lead: Create the agent’s singleton knowledge base or update its settings.
important: Create the agent’s singleton knowledge base or change its settings; this does not attach another agent’s base.
An existing base needs its current revision. Saving settings does not publish source text.

api.title: Get knowledge base
api.description: Read knowledge settings, revision and the active published index. Use the current revision when preparing a guarded edit.
api.lead: Read a knowledge base’s settings, revision and active published index.
important: Read the current base and revision before editing.
A revision is a concurrency guard, not an idempotency key.

api.title: Get knowledge overview
api.description: Read knowledge topic, token, publication and review totals, plus seven-day observations, without inferring publication from a source count.
api.lead: Read topic, token, publication, review and seven-day observation totals.
important: Use the overview for current source, topic and job state.
Do not infer publication from a source or job count alone.

api.title: Read automatic keyterms
api.description: Read ranked automatic speech terms from live agent knowledge, with configured limits and saved manual terms for comparison.
api.lead: Read ranked automatic speech terms from an agent’s current live knowledge.
important: Automatic candidates default to 80, with an operator-configurable cap of 100; newly edited manual lists have a separate 20-term limit.
Read the actual effective list; terms are recognition hints, not extra knowledge answers.

api.title: Get knowledge usage
api.description: Read private knowledge storage inventory and compatibility allowance counters. These values are not a complete billing ledger.
api.lead: Read private storage inventory and compatibility allowance counters.
important: Read the returned private storage inventory and compatibility allowance counters.
These counters are not a complete billing ledger.

api.title: Read knowledge events
api.description: Read ordered knowledge events for the owning account. Keep the documented paging and filters while reconciling changes.
api.lead: Read ordered owner-scoped knowledge events for reconciliation.
important: Read events using their documented paging and filters.
Events describe available history, not guaranteed delivery to another system.

api.title: Measure knowledge source
api.description: Measure source token usage before import without storing or publishing the source. The preview does not reserve later quota.
api.lead: Preview source token usage before an import without storing the source.
important: Measure the proposed source before importing it.
Measurement does not publish text or reserve quota for a later import.

api.title: Import knowledge source
api.description: Import pasted text or a supported raw file and track preparation. Review flags can require approval before publication.
api.lead: Submit pasted text or a raw file and queue preparation of original-word pieces.
important: Use pasted text or a raw supported file; websites use discovery and selection.
API review:false can publish after preparation, but flags still require review.

api.title: List knowledge sources
api.description: List accepted sources with unsuppressed live pieces. Use their saved source IDs for renaming, replacement and deletion.
api.lead: List accepted sources that still have unsuppressed live pieces.
important: Use saved source IDs for rename, replacement or deletion.
A source's presence does not mean all its prepared text is published.

api.title: Rename knowledge source
api.description: Rename a saved knowledge source without changing its facts or published index. Confirm the exact source and revision first.
api.lead: Change a source name without changing facts or the published index.
important: Rename the exact saved source.
A title change does not replace its underlying text.

api.title: Replace knowledge source
api.description: Prepare replacement source text while keeping the accepted version available until the reviewed replacement is published.
api.lead: Prepare replacement source text while preserving the accepted version until publication.
important: Keep the expected revision and intended source identity.
Review the replacement job; accepted work is not completed publication.

api.title: Refresh website sources
api.description: Refresh selected saved website sources and follow the resulting job. New website content can still require review.
api.lead: Refresh explicitly selected saved website sources.
important: Refresh eligible website sources under the documented limits.
A refresh can need review; do not assume discovered changes became live answers.

api.title: Delete knowledge source
api.description: Remove an accepted knowledge source with explicit affected-topic confirmation and revision checks, then follow its result.
api.lead: Remove an accepted source with explicit confirmation of affected topics.
important: Delete the intended source using its current revision.
Track cleanup and publication state rather than treating acceptance as completion.

api.title: Discover website pages
api.description: Discover selectable public website pages without importing or publishing them. Use the returned page IDs for a later selection.
api.lead: Discover selectable public pages without importing or publishing them.
important: Discover public pages before selecting an import.
Discovery does not import every URL or grant access to private pages.

api.title: Import selected pages
api.description: Import selected page IDs from a completed owned website discovery, then follow preparation and any required review.
api.lead: Import only pages chosen from a completed owned website discovery.
important: Send selected discovery page IDs exactly as returned.
Follow the preparation job and required review before claiming publication.

api.title: Get knowledge draft
api.description: Read proposed knowledge pieces, flags, reminders and the draft revision before editing or approving the selected content.
api.lead: Read proposed pieces, review flags, reminders and draft revision.
important: Read the draft and its current revision before editing or accepting.
A preview scan is not publication clearance; review flagged content.

api.title: Edit knowledge draft
api.description: Edit a proposed knowledge piece while preserving evidence and review requirements. Resolve revision conflicts before saving.
api.lead: Edit one proposed piece while preserving evidence and review requirements.
important: Send edits against the current draft revision.
On a revision conflict, reread and merge intentionally.

api.title: Accept knowledge draft
api.description: Approve selected reviewed knowledge pieces and queue publication. Follow the job before claiming the new answers are live.
api.lead: Approve an explicit selection of reviewed pieces and queue publication.
important: Accept only the reviewed draft and current revision.
Follow the resulting publication work; acceptance alone is not proof it is live.

api.title: Discard knowledge draft
api.description: Discard a knowledge review draft while retaining the currently published knowledge. Confirm the intended draft before removal.
api.lead: Discard a review draft while retaining currently published knowledge.
important: Discard the intended unaccepted draft.
This does not automatically remove already published knowledge.

api.title: List knowledge topics
api.description: List current knowledge pieces in stable display order and retain the returned topic identities when opening or editing a piece.
api.lead: List current pieces in their stable display order.
important: Use the current topic IDs and paging values.
One list page is not the whole knowledge base.

api.title: Get knowledge topic
api.description: Read one current knowledge piece, its evidence and saved metadata before preparing a revision-guarded edit.
api.lead: Read one current piece, its evidence and saved metadata.
important: Read the exact topic and revision before updating.
Preserve source context and distinguish draft from published text.

api.title: Create knowledge topic
api.description: Create a manually written knowledge piece and prepare a fresh index. Check the resulting job before claiming publication.
api.lead: Create a manually written piece and prepare a fresh index.
important: Create a focused topic with the documented operation key.
Read the resulting job or revision before claiming the answer is live.

api.title: Update knowledge topic
api.description: Correct a live knowledge piece with its current revision and prepare a replacement index without silently overwriting newer work.
api.lead: Correct a live piece and prepare its replacement index.
important: Apply a narrow edit against the current revision.
Resolve a conflict by reviewing newer text, not by discarding the guard.

api.title: Delete knowledge topic
api.description: Remove a current knowledge piece and prevent a source refresh from restoring it. Confirm the revision and track the returned work.
api.lead: Remove a current piece and prevent source refresh from restoring it.
important: Confirm the topic and current revision before deletion.
Track the returned work before showing completion.

api.title: Search knowledge topics
api.description: Find related current topics in one knowledge base for management. Search results do not predict an agent’s answer on a real call.
api.lead: Find related current topics for knowledge management.
important: Search the chosen base with a bounded query.
A search result is not proof of how an agent will answer a real call.

api.title: List unanswered questions
api.description: Read recent real questions without a retrieval match. Review the question before turning it into a trusted knowledge answer.
api.lead: Read recent real questions from delivered turns without a retrieval match.
important: Review actual unanswered questions within the returned scope.
Do not turn a customer's question into a trusted fact without review.

api.title: Update knowledge settings
api.description: Update knowledge channels, matching mode or the not-found sentence, using the required guards and preserving omitted settings.
api.lead: Change enabled channels, matching mode or the not-found sentence.
important: Change only the intended settings with the required guards.
Read back the saved values before changing your UI's assumptions.

api.title: Start knowledge test
api.description: Start a knowledge-only simulated session for an agent with live knowledge. This does not place a real telephone call.
api.lead: Start a knowledge-only simulated test session for an agent with live knowledge.
important: A test session checks the selected agent's knowledge.
It is separate from a real telephone call and still follows its documented usage limits.

api.title: Get knowledge test session
api.description: Read the saved knowledge-test conversation and current session state. Missing answers and failed reads remain unconfirmed.
api.lead: Read the saved knowledge-only conversation and its current state.
important: Read the saved session and its state.
A missing answer or failed read is not a successful knowledge test.

api.title: Ask a knowledge test question
api.description: Ask a simulated knowledge question and inspect its supplied-piece evidence. Keep one operation identity for the intended message.
api.lead: Ask a simulated question using current knowledge and return supplied-piece evidence.
important: Save one operation identity for the intended test message.
Check the answer and cited knowledge; replay does not authorise duplicate paid work.

api.title: Cancel knowledge test
api.description: Cancel a simulated knowledge session and related unfinished work. Cancellation does not undo work already performed.
api.lead: Cancel a simulated test session and related unfinished work.
important: Cancel the intended active test session.
Work already performed is not undone by cancellation.

api.title: Get knowledge job
api.description: Read knowledge job state, progress, result and safe failure details. Interpret readiness using the job kind and result.
api.lead: Poll authoritative job state, progress, result and safe failure details.
important: Follow state, stage and error together.
ready does not always mean text was published; inspect the job kind and result.

api.title: Retry knowledge job
api.description: Retry a failed knowledge job only when its revision and attempt limit permit it. Review the recorded cause first.
api.lead: Retry a failed job when its revision and attempt limit still permit it.
important: Retry only a job that the API permits to retry.
Fix its recorded failure first; a new request is not a universal recovery mechanism.

api.title: Cancel knowledge job
api.description: Cancel unfinished knowledge work before installation while keeping published knowledge and work already performed.
api.lead: Cancel pending work before installation while keeping published knowledge.
important: Cancel eligible unfinished work.
Cancellation cannot undo a completed publication or work already charged.

api.title: Create knowledge export
api.description: Queue a private export of accepted knowledge and settings, then wait for readiness before requesting the download.
api.lead: Queue a private export of accepted knowledge and settings.
important: Create an export for the intended base and revision.
Wait for export readiness before requesting the download.

api.title: Download knowledge export
api.description: Download a ready private knowledge export as structured JSON or readable text through the authenticated export route.
api.lead: Download a ready private export as structured JSON or readable text.
important: Download the prepared export through the authenticated route.
Keep private knowledge files out of public URLs and logs.

api.title: Delete agent knowledge
api.description: Revoke an agent’s live knowledge and queue private-data deletion. Follow the job and remaining-object count to confirm cleanup.
api.lead: Revoke an agent’s live knowledge immediately and queue private-data deletion.
important: Access is revoked before private-data cleanup finishes; confirm the intended agent first.
Follow the deletion job until deleted and private_objects_remaining is zero. The revoked deletion cannot be cancelled.

api.title: Read web agent settings
api.description: Read website agent settings for one owned number, including its current revision and optional appearance configuration.
api.lead: Read website agent settings for one owned number, including its current revision and optional appearance configuration.
important: Read the web settings for the owned number.
A saved setting is not a live browser connection test.

api.title: Update web agent settings
api.description: Update website agent settings for one owned number using its current revision. A stale revision is refused so another editor’s change is preserved.
api.lead: Update website agent settings for one owned number using its current revision. A stale revision is refused so another editor’s change is preserved.
important: Change only the intended web settings.
Read back the result and test the actual browser flow before rollout.

api.title: Check inbox availability
api.description: Check whether the Nixflex agent inbox is enabled on this service. The feature check remains available when other inbox operations are disabled.
api.lead: Read whether the agent inbox feature is enabled on this service. This check remains available when inbox operations are disabled.
important: Use the enabled boolean to decide whether to show the inbox.
A failed availability request is not the same as enabled:false.

api.title: List inbox numbers
api.description: List owned numbers available to the Nixflex inbox and their active agent labels. Pending number imports are excluded from the list.
api.lead: List owned numbers available to the inbox and active agent labels. Pending number imports are excluded; both API and dashboard number sources can appear.
important: Use the returned eligible channel and number combination.
Do not infer inbox access from an unrelated phone-number list.

api.title: List inbox conversations
api.description: List conversations for one owned number and channel. Read-only listing does not mark messages as read.
api.lead: List conversations for one owned number and channel. Read-only listing does not mark messages as read.
important: Keep the channel and number fixed while paging.
A conversation summary is not the full message thread.

api.title: Read an inbox thread
api.description: Read retained messages in one owned Nixflex inbox thread. The newest page is selected first, with its messages returned in chronological order.
api.lead: Read retained messages in one owned inbox conversation. The newest page is selected first and returned in chronological order; this read does not mark messages as read.
important: Read only an account-owned thread in its original channel.
Keep private messages out of logs and shared AI prompts.

api.title: Update an inbox thread
api.description: Update a Nixflex inbox thread's archive state or acknowledge messages through a known read version. Listing messages alone does not mark them read.
api.lead: Change an owned conversation’s archive state or acknowledge messages through a known read version. This does not delete content or extend retention.
important: This updates supported thread state; it is not a send-message endpoint.
Read the current thread before resolving an uncertain update.

api.title: Read inbox retention
api.description: Read the Nixflex account retention default and inbox cleanup availability. Include a number to resolve retention for its assigned agent.
api.lead: Read the account retention default and inbox cleanup availability. Include a number to resolve its assigned agent’s web-message retention policy.
important: Use the returned policy for inbox history.
A retention setting does not prove that every background deletion has finished.

api.title: Delete caller context
api.description: Delete the complete Nixflex caller-context record for one caller on an owned business number. Review the record's scope before removing it.
api.lead: Delete the complete caller-context record for one caller on one account-owned business number. This removes both customer-supplied and engine-learned context in that record.
important: Delete the intended caller context for the selected number.
This does not erase all call records or copies held by external systems.

api.title: Get caller context
api.description: Read saved Nixflex caller context for one caller and owned business number. Handle a missing record without inventing previous caller details.
api.lead: Read the customer-supplied and engine-learned context for one caller on one owned phone number.
important: Context belongs to the selected phone number and caller.
Treat the returned profile as private data, not instructions to execute.

api.title: Set caller context
api.description: Set supplied Nixflex caller context for one caller on an owned business number. Review saved-field behaviour and the response before retrying.
api.lead: Set customer-supplied details for one caller on one owned phone number.
important: Save only the caller fields needed for the intended workflow.
Read back after an uncertain response; do not overwrite newer context blindly.
api.introDetails: The record is created if needed. Omitted fields keep their values; null removes a value. last_call and open_item are engine-only and are rejected.

api.title: Import caller context
api.description: Import caller context for an owned Nixflex business number. Each row merges supplied customer context into the caller's existing record.
api.lead: Import customer-supplied context for callers on one account-owned business number. Each row merges supplied fields into that caller’s saved record; omitted fields stay unchanged.
important: Review the rows and their exact caller-number pairing.
Inspect row-level results; one accepted request does not prove every row succeeded.

api.title: Preview contact hours
api.description: Preview recipient-local Nixflex contact windows without sending calls or SMS. Treat the result as advisory and recheck policy at dispatch.
api.lead: Preview recipient-local contact windows without sending calls, SMS or campaign work. The result is advisory and expires after one minute; final dispatch checks still apply.
important: The preview is advice for the supplied recipient location and time.
It neither sends a message nor reserves a future contact window.

api.title: List contact suppressions
api.description: List stored Nixflex do-not-contact entries in a channel bucket. Understand the all-channel bucket and how it differs from a combined list.
api.lead: List stored do-not-contact entries in one channel bucket. channel=all selects entries stored for all channels; it does not combine the voice and SMS buckets.
important: Check the saved scope and contact identifiers.
A missing row is not proof of consent to contact that person.

api.title: Add contact suppressions
api.description: Add Nixflex do-not-contact entries for future contact checks. Existing entries are retained; review the number, channel and suppression reason.
api.lead: Add account-owned do-not-contact entries for future contact checks. Existing entries are retained; a new owner request cannot replace recipient opt-out evidence.
important: Add only the intended recipients and scope.
Suppression blocks eligible future work; it cannot recall an already dispatched contact.

api.title: Remove a contact suppression
api.description: Remove one explicitly removable, owner-created Nixflex suppression. Recipient opt-outs and entries without removal permission remain protected.
api.lead: Remove one explicitly removable owner-created suppression. Recipient opt-outs and entries without verified owner-removal permission remain locked.
important: Removing suppression changes future contact eligibility.
It does not grant consent or override recipient-local contact hours.

api.title: Get Cal.com settings
api.description: Read the saved Cal.com settings for an owned phone number. Secret values are represented by configuration flags.
api.lead: Read the saved Cal.com settings for an owned phone number. Secret values are represented by configuration flags.
important: Read the current setting for this exact owned target before changing it.
Only one booking provider can be active for a number.

api.title: Set Cal.com settings
api.description: Replace Cal.com settings for one owned number. Omitted configuration values do not retain the previous saved values.
api.lead: Save Cal.com settings for an owned phone number. This replaces the saved configuration for this integration; omitted configuration values do not preserve the old values.
important: Save the setting for the exact owned target, then read it back to confirm.
Only one booking provider can be active for a number.

api.title: Delete Cal.com settings
api.description: Remove saved Cal.com settings for an owned Nixflex number. This clears the integration configuration without disconnecting the phone number.
api.lead: Remove the saved Cal.com configuration scoped to this account and number. This does not disconnect the phone number. A missing configuration also returns success.
important: Clear only the intended target setting; already dispatched work cannot be recalled.
Only one booking provider can be active for a number.

api.title: Get Slack settings
api.description: Read the saved Slack settings for an owned phone number. Secret values are represented by configuration flags.
api.lead: Read the saved Slack settings for an owned phone number. Secret values are represented by configuration flags.
important: Read the current setting for this exact owned target before changing it.
Saving a destination does not prove a notification reached the channel.

api.title: Set Slack settings
api.description: Replace saved Slack settings for an owned Nixflex number. Supply the complete intended configuration and review omitted-field behaviour.
api.lead: Save Slack settings for an owned phone number. This replaces the saved configuration for this integration; omitted configuration values do not preserve the old values.
important: Save the setting for the exact owned target, then read it back to confirm.
Saving a destination does not prove a notification reached the channel.

api.title: Delete Slack settings
api.description: Remove saved Slack settings for an owned Nixflex number. This clears the integration configuration without disconnecting the phone number.
api.lead: Remove the saved Slack configuration scoped to this account and number. This does not disconnect the phone number. A missing configuration also returns success.
important: Clear only the intended target setting; already dispatched work cannot be recalled.
Saving a destination does not prove a notification reached the channel.

api.title: Get Zapier settings
api.description: Read the saved Zapier settings for an owned phone number. Secret values are represented by configuration flags.
api.lead: Read the saved Zapier settings for an owned phone number. Secret values are represented by configuration flags.
important: Read the current setting for this exact owned target before changing it.
An automation destination must handle retries without repeating business actions.

api.title: Set Zapier settings
api.description: Replace Zapier settings for one owned number, then read back the destination. Saving it does not prove event delivery.
api.lead: Save Zapier settings for an owned phone number. This replaces the saved configuration for this integration; omitted configuration values do not preserve the old values.
important: Save the setting for the exact owned target, then read it back to confirm.
An automation destination must handle retries without repeating business actions.

api.title: Delete Zapier settings
api.description: Remove saved Zapier settings for an owned Nixflex number. This clears the integration configuration without disconnecting the phone number.
api.lead: Remove the saved Zapier configuration scoped to this account and number. This does not disconnect the phone number. A missing configuration also returns success.
important: Clear only the intended target setting; already dispatched work cannot be recalled.
An automation destination must handle retries without repeating business actions.

api.title: Get Make settings
api.description: Read the saved Make settings for an owned phone number. Secret values are represented by configuration flags.
api.lead: Read the saved Make settings for an owned phone number. Secret values are represented by configuration flags.
important: Read the current setting for this exact owned target before changing it.
An automation destination must handle retries without repeating business actions.

api.title: Set Make settings
api.description: Replace saved Make settings for an owned Nixflex number. Supply the complete intended configuration and review omitted-field behaviour.
api.lead: Save Make settings for an owned phone number. This replaces the saved configuration for this integration; omitted configuration values do not preserve the old values.
important: Save the setting for the exact owned target, then read it back to confirm.
An automation destination must handle retries without repeating business actions.

api.title: Delete Make settings
api.description: Remove the saved Make configuration scoped to this account and number. This does not disconnect the phone number. A missing configuration also returns success.
api.lead: Remove the saved Make configuration scoped to this account and number. This does not disconnect the phone number. A missing configuration also returns success.
important: Clear only the intended target setting; already dispatched work cannot be recalled.
An automation destination must handle retries without repeating business actions.

api.title: Get GoHighLevel settings
api.description: Read saved GoHighLevel settings for an owned Nixflex number. Configuration flags indicate secret presence without returning secret values.
api.lead: Read the saved GoHighLevel settings for an owned phone number. Secret values are represented by configuration flags.
important: Read the current setting for this exact owned target before changing it.
A saved connection is not proof that a contact update reached the external system.

api.title: Set GoHighLevel settings
api.description: Replace saved GoHighLevel settings for an owned Nixflex number. Supply the complete intended configuration for this integration.
api.lead: Save GoHighLevel settings for an owned phone number. This replaces the saved configuration for this integration; omitted configuration values do not preserve the old values.
important: Save the setting for the exact owned target, then read it back to confirm.
A saved connection is not proof that a contact update reached the external system.

api.title: Delete GoHighLevel settings
api.description: Remove saved GoHighLevel settings for an owned Nixflex number. This clears the integration configuration without disconnecting the phone number.
api.lead: Remove the saved GoHighLevel configuration scoped to this account and number. This does not disconnect the phone number. A missing configuration also returns success.
important: Clear only the intended target setting; already dispatched work cannot be recalled.
A saved connection is not proof that a contact update reached the external system.

api.title: Get pre-call gate for number
api.description: Read the pre-call gate for an owned Nixflex number. A saved number-specific gate overrides the default from its assigned agent.
api.lead: Read the saved pre-call gate setting for an owned number. A number-specific gate overrides its agent default. Clearing it restores the agent default when one exists.
important: Read the current setting for this exact owned target before changing it.
The five-second pre-call hook is fail-open; it is not a guaranteed call-blocking control.

api.title: Get pre-call gate for agent
api.description: Read an owned Nixflex agent's default pre-call gate. Number-specific settings can override this default for individual numbers.
api.lead: Read the saved pre-call gate setting for an owned agent. This is the default for numbers on the agent; a number-specific gate takes precedence.
important: Read the current setting for this exact owned target before changing it.
The five-second pre-call hook is fail-open; it is not a guaranteed call-blocking control.

api.title: Set pre-call gate for number
api.description: Set the pre-call gate setting for an owned number. A number-specific gate overrides its agent default. Clearing it restores the agent default when one exists.
api.lead: Set the pre-call gate setting for an owned number. A number-specific gate overrides its agent default. Clearing it restores the agent default when one exists.
important: Save the setting for the exact owned target, then read it back to confirm.
The five-second pre-call hook is fail-open; it is not a guaranteed call-blocking control.

api.title: Set pre-call gate for agent
api.description: Set an owned Nixflex agent's default pre-call gate. Number-specific settings can override this default for individual numbers.
api.lead: Set the pre-call gate setting for an owned agent. This is the default for numbers on the agent; a number-specific gate takes precedence.
important: Save the setting for the exact owned target, then read it back to confirm.
The five-second pre-call hook is fail-open; it is not a guaranteed call-blocking control.

api.title: Clear pre-call gate for number
api.description: Clear a saved number-specific Nixflex pre-call gate. Review the assigned agent's default when deciding the number's resulting gate behaviour.
api.lead: Clear the saved pre-call gate setting for an owned number. A number-specific gate overrides its agent default. Clearing it restores the agent default when one exists.
important: Clear only the intended target setting; already dispatched work cannot be recalled.
The five-second pre-call hook is fail-open; it is not a guaranteed call-blocking control.

api.title: Clear pre-call gate for agent
api.description: Clear the saved pre-call gate setting for an owned agent. This is the default for numbers on the agent; a number-specific gate takes precedence.
api.lead: Clear the saved pre-call gate setting for an owned agent. This is the default for numbers on the agent; a number-specific gate takes precedence.
important: Clear only the intended target setting; already dispatched work cannot be recalled.
The five-second pre-call hook is fail-open; it is not a guaranteed call-blocking control.

api.title: List custom functions
api.description: List up to 15 saved custom functions for an owned Nixflex number. An empty list means no matching functions are saved for that account and number.
api.lead: Read up to 15 saved custom functions for this account and number. No matching rows returns an empty list; the handler does not separately prove number ownership.
important: Read the current setting for this exact owned target before changing it.
Verify signed inputs before executing consequential work.

api.title: Create a custom function
api.description: Create a custom function for an owned Nixflex number. Each number allows up to 15 functions with names unique within that number.
api.lead: Create one function for an owned number. Each number can have at most 15 functions; names must be unique for that number.
important: Save the setting for the exact owned target, then read it back to confirm.
Verify signed inputs before executing consequential work.

api.title: Update a custom function
api.description: Update selected fields of a custom function for an owned Nixflex number. Omitted fields keep their saved values.
api.lead: Change only supplied fields of one owned custom function. Omitted fields keep their saved values; this does not create a missing function.
important: Save the setting for the exact owned target, then read it back to confirm.
Verify signed inputs before executing consequential work.

api.title: Delete a custom function
api.description: Delete one custom function by its account, Nixflex number and function ID. Review the response and missing-function behaviour before retrying.
api.lead: Remove one custom function scoped to the account, number and function ID. A missing matching row also returns success.
important: Clear only the intended target setting; already dispatched work cannot be recalled.
Verify signed inputs before executing consequential work.

api.title: Get first webhook
api.description: Read the primary webhook setting for an owned Nixflex number. Primary and secondary slots are configured independently.
api.lead: Read the saved first webhook setting for an owned number. Each webhook slot is independent. Saved destinations receive call events when the relevant delivery feature is available.
important: Read the current setting for this exact owned target before changing it.
Verify raw-body signatures and deduplicate durably before acknowledging events.

api.title: Get second webhook
api.description: Read the secondary webhook setting for an owned Nixflex number. Secondary and primary slots are configured independently.
api.lead: Read the saved second webhook setting for an owned number. Each webhook slot is independent. Saved destinations receive call events when the relevant delivery feature is available.
important: Read the current setting for this exact owned target before changing it.
Verify raw-body signatures and deduplicate durably before acknowledging events.

api.title: Set first webhook
api.description: Set the primary webhook for an owned Nixflex number. Review event contracts, signature verification and duplicate delivery handling.
api.lead: Set the first webhook setting for an owned number. Each webhook slot is independent. Saved destinations receive call events when the relevant delivery feature is available.
important: Save the setting for the exact owned target, then read it back to confirm.
Verify raw-body signatures and deduplicate durably before acknowledging events.

api.title: Set second webhook
api.description: Set the secondary webhook for an owned Nixflex number. Review event contracts, signature verification and duplicate delivery handling.
api.lead: Set the second webhook setting for an owned number. Each webhook slot is independent. Saved destinations receive call events when the relevant delivery feature is available.
important: Save the setting for the exact owned target, then read it back to confirm.
Verify raw-body signatures and deduplicate durably before acknowledging events.

api.title: Clear first webhook
api.description: Clear the primary webhook setting for an owned Nixflex number. This request targets the primary slot independently of the secondary slot.
api.lead: Clear the saved first webhook setting for an owned number. Each webhook slot is independent. Saved destinations receive call events when the relevant delivery feature is available.
important: Clear only the intended target setting; already dispatched work cannot be recalled.
Verify raw-body signatures and deduplicate durably before acknowledging events.

api.title: Clear second webhook
api.description: Clear the secondary webhook setting for an owned Nixflex number. This request targets the secondary slot independently of the primary slot.
api.lead: Clear the saved second webhook setting for an owned number. Each webhook slot is independent. Saved destinations receive call events when the relevant delivery feature is available.
important: Clear only the intended target setting; already dispatched work cannot be recalled.
Verify raw-body signatures and deduplicate durably before acknowledging events.

api.title: Get web calls
api.description: Read the website voice-call switch for an owned number. Reading the saved setting does not start or prove a browser call.
api.lead: Read the saved web calls setting for an owned number. This controls the saved number switch for website voice calls. Reading or changing the switch does not start a call.
important: Read the current setting for this exact owned target before changing it.
A saved web-call configuration is not proof a browser session connected.

api.title: Set web calls
api.description: Set the website voice-call switch for an owned Nixflex number. Review its saved state without starting a web call.
api.lead: Set the web calls setting for an owned number. This controls the saved number switch for website voice calls. Reading or changing the switch does not start a call.
important: Save the setting for the exact owned target, then read it back to confirm.
A saved web-call configuration is not proof a browser session connected.

api.title: Clear web calls
api.description: Clear the website voice-call switch for an owned number. This changes configuration without starting a browser call.
api.lead: Clear the saved web calls setting for an owned number. This controls the saved number switch for website voice calls. Reading or changing the switch does not start a call.
important: Clear only the intended target setting; already dispatched work cannot be recalled.
A saved web-call configuration is not proof a browser session connected.

api.title: Check organisation roles and permissions
api.description: Compare Owner, Admin and Member permissions in Nixflex. Keep server-side API key authority separate from personal dashboard sessions and membership checks.
api.lead: Check the actor role and operation before offering an organisation action in your app.
important: Use the actor role and the target action together to decide access.
Never use an organisation key to bypass a personal role restriction in a client.

api.title: Get organisation context
api.description: Read the Nixflex organisation selected by the authenticated credential, including its current permissions and account context.
api.lead: Read the organisation selected by the authenticated credential. The result includes current permissions and identity fields, without a signing secret or balance.
important: Use this context to render the current organisation and role.
An account API key and a personal session have different authority.

api.title: List organisation members
api.description: List Nixflex organisation members, up to 100 pending or expired invitations, and current safety limits. Review role permissions before changes.
api.lead: Read active members, up to 100 pending or expired invitations, and current safety limits. The Owner and Admin can view the team; Members cannot.
important: Use member IDs from this organisation for later actions.
Do not expose private membership data in public pages or logs.

api.title: List organisation activity
api.description: Read Nixflex organisation activity, newest first, with up to 50 events per JSON page. Check role permissions and paging rules.
api.lead: Read current organisation activity, newest first. JSON pages contain up to 50 events. Owner and Admin personal sessions can read activity.
important: Use activity as an audit trail within its retention limits.
An activity row is not a complete provider delivery or billing record.

api.title: Request an owner claim
api.description: Invite a verified recipient to claim an existing, unclaimed Nixflex API-only account. Sending the invitation does not complete the claim.
api.lead: Start an email invitation to claim this existing, unclaimed API-only account. The verified recipient must accept using their own personal login; this does not create an account or new credit.
important: This starts the documented owner-claim flow.
Requesting a claim does not itself prove ownership or grant Owner access.

api.title: Invite a teammate
api.description: Send a 24-hour Nixflex team invitation. The recipient must accept using their own verified login; opening the email does not add membership.
api.lead: Send a 24-hour team invitation. The invited person accepts using their own verified login. Opening an email does not accept the invitation.
important: Invite the intended person with the allowed role.
An accepted invitation request does not prove the email was delivered or accepted.

api.title: Resend a team invitation
api.description: Replace a Nixflex team invitation with a new ID and 24-hour link. The previous link becomes invalid and sending limits still apply.
api.lead: Invalidate the old invitation and send a replacement with a new ID and 24-hour link. Resending uses the daily invitation quota again.
important: Use the existing invitation ID and respect its current state.
A resend does not guarantee email delivery or reset every invitation rule.

api.title: Revoke a team invitation
api.description: Revoke a pending or expired Nixflex invitation before acceptance. The link becomes invalid; this does not remove an existing team member.
api.lead: Revoke a pending or expired invitation before it is accepted. This invalidates its link; it does not remove an existing teammate.
important: Revoke the intended invitation before it is claimed.
Read the result; revocation is not the same as removing an existing member.

api.title: Change an organisation role
api.description: Change a non-Owner Nixflex member to Admin or Member using Owner authority. Review the resulting permissions before saving the role.
api.lead: Change a non-Owner member to Admin or Member. Only Owner authority may change roles. This is not an ownership transfer.
important: Check the actor's role and the target's current role first.
Owner protections still apply; a client must not work around a refused role change.

api.title: Remove an organisation member
api.description: Remove one non-Owner member from a Nixflex organisation. Shared work and the shared API key remain; review any separate access that also needs removal.
api.lead: Remove one non-Owner member from this organisation. Shared work and the shared API key remain. A successful response does not always confirm live disconnection.
important: Check who will lose access before removing a member.
Owner and self-removal rules differ; follow the returned refusal.

api.title: Rename an organisation
api.description: Rename a Nixflex organisation using its API key or the Owner's personal session. Set the business name shown for that organisation.
api.lead: Set the business name shown for this organisation. Only the Owner personal session or the organisation API key can rename it.
important: This changes the organisation display name.
It does not change account identity, credentials or ownership.

api.title: Get the signing secret
api.description: Privately retrieve the Nixflex organisation signing secret to verify event deliveries. Keep it server-side and out of logs, browsers and shared output.
api.lead: Explicitly retrieve the organisation signing secret for verifying event deliveries. Keep the result in a private secret store; never expose it in logs, chat or tool output.
important: Retrieve this secret only through the authorised Owner workflow.
Keep the stable signing secret separate from the API credential and out of logs.

api.title: Create an API account
api.description: Create a separate Nixflex API-only account and its credential. This does not add another key to an existing account.
api.lead: Create a separate API-only account and its credential. This does not add another key to an existing organisation, create a dashboard login, or grant trial credit.
important: This creates a real account credential; save it in secret storage.
A lost response must be reconciled before creating another account.

api.title: Rotate the API key
api.description: Rotate the Nixflex account's API secret immediately while keeping its key ID. Plan the change because the old secret stops working.
api.lead: Replace the current account secret immediately. The key ID remains the same; the old secret stops working when rotation succeeds. The organisation signing secret is separate and does not rotate here.
important: Rotation changes the credential used by your applications.
Save and deploy the new secret safely; never repeat rotation merely to check progress.

api.title: Get account usage
api.description: Read Nixflex account usage and call-capacity information. Occupancy can include unresolved reservations as well as active calls.
api.lead: Read stored account usage and call-capacity information. Occupancy can include unresolved reservations, so it is not simply the number of connected conversations.
important: Use the returned max_concurrent value for this account.
Usage counters and unresolved reservations are not the same as an invoice or connected-call count.

api.title: Get account retention
api.description: Read the Nixflex account retention default for new agents. Existing agents retain their saved settings until explicitly updated.
api.lead: Read the account retention default for new agents. Existing agents keep their saved retention settings; use Update an agent to change one agent.
important: Read the saved account retention policy.
Policy values alone do not prove pending cleanup is complete.

api.title: Get key activity
api.description: Read a snapshot of retained Nixflex API request activity for the account. Distinguish request logs from call history and billing usage.
api.lead: Read a single snapshot of retained API request activity for the authenticated account. This is request activity, separate from organisation audit events and call usage.
important: Read key activity without exposing the credential itself.
Activity is bounded by its available history and retention.

api.title: List voices
api.description: List voices visible to the Nixflex account. Check compatibility for the optional agent context before choosing a voice.
api.lead: List the voices visible to this account. Compatibility is calculated for the optional agent context; catalog availability can change before a call.
important: Use returned voice keys when choosing an available voice.
Choose from voices already in the catalogue.

api.title: Get a voice
api.description: Read a voice visible to the Nixflex account and its compatibility with an optional agent language. A successful read does not guarantee compatibility.
api.lead: Read a voice visible to this account and its compatibility with an optional agent language. A successful read can return selectable: false; read the reason before using the voice.
important: Keep the exact voice key from the catalogue.
A missing or unavailable voice needs a deliberate alternative, not a guessed key.

api.title: Connect Google Calendar
api.description: Connect Google Calendar to an owned Nixflex number. Create a consent link, handle return codes and keep OAuth credentials private.
api.lead: Connect Google Calendar to an owned Nixflex number. Create a consent link, handle return codes and keep OAuth credentials private.
important: Open the returned consent link in the user's browser; it expires after ten minutes.
Consent connects one owned number. It is not proof that any appointment was booked.

api.title: Get Google Calendar status
api.description: Read the Google Calendar connection for an owned Nixflex number, including reconnect state and whether caller invitations are enabled.
api.lead: Read the Google Calendar connection for an owned Nixflex number, including reconnect state and whether caller invitations are enabled.
important: connected:false is different from a failed status read.
needs_reconnect asks for fresh consent; reconnect keeps business settings.

api.title: Disconnect Google Calendar
api.description: Disconnect Google Calendar from an owned Nixflex number. Remove local access and understand in-flight bookings and shared Google grants.
api.lead: Disconnect Google Calendar from an owned Nixflex number. Remove local access and understand in-flight bookings and shared Google grants.
important: Disconnect the intended number deliberately.
Already dispatched calendar work cannot be recalled by removing the connection.

api.title: Update Google Calendar settings
api.description: Set calendar timezone, weekly hours, slot length and caller invitations for an owned Nixflex number. Omitted settings retain their saved value.
api.lead: Set calendar timezone, weekly hours, slot length and caller invitations for an owned Nixflex number. Omitted settings retain their saved value.
important: Send all seven days when changing working_hours and use an IANA time zone.
send_invites requests Google notifications; it does not prove inbox delivery.

api.title: Update phone number credentials
api.description: Update carrier credentials for an imported Nixflex phone number in place. Preserve settings and handle uncertain routing or credential saves safely.
api.lead: Update carrier credentials for an imported Nixflex phone number in place. Preserve settings and handle uncertain routing or credential saves safely.
important: Use exactly one supported credential pair; do not mix carrier fields.
This replaces connection credentials. Keep both request and response out of logs.

api.title: Receive booking results: call.bookings
api.description: Receive confirmed Nixflex booking actions and their final results after a call. Verify signatures, count active bookings and handle duplicate deliveries.
api.lead: Receive confirmed calendar mutations and their final booking results after a call ends.
important: timeline lists confirmed actions; final shows the result per booking UID.
Count active final rows. Creating then cancelling leaves zero active bookings.

api.title: Read call booking results
api.description: Read confirmed booking results for a Nixflex call. Distinguish ready, none, processing, deleted and unavailable without guessing from a transcript.
api.lead: Read the retained booking result for one account-owned call. Only ready returns confirmed mutations and their final results.
important: Only ready returns a confirmed booking result; every other state has result:null.
none needs complete evidence of zero successful mutations. unavailable is not an empty result.

api.title: Read an outbound call request
api.description: Check a Nixflex outbound request by its saved UUID. Keep pending and unknown outcomes distinct and avoid starting a duplicate call.
api.lead: Check the durable state of the UUID saved for an outbound call intent. This read never dispatches a call, reserves capacity or charges.
important: This read cannot place a call, reserve capacity or charge the account.
pending and unknown mean keep the same UUID and reconcile; accepted gives the saved call ID.
